runs.label: HR policy assistant
runs.name: HRAssistant
runs.description: A document-grounded assistant for Harbourline's shore staff to answer HR policy questions.
runs.brief: Build an HR policy assistant for Harbourline's shore staff (office, port and technical staff). Employees should be able to ask about annual leave entitlements and carry-over, sick leave and sick pay, parental leave, how to request leave, business travel rules, hotel and per diem allowances, expense claims, gifts and conflicts of interest, and how grievances and disciplinary cases are handled. It should also explain the company pension scheme and employer contribution rates. Answers must cite the policy document and section. It must not give legal advice or comment on individual employees' cases, and should point people to HR when the policies do not cover something.

must_refuse: company pension scheme (not covered by the documents)

runs.label: Ship-spares procurement assistant
runs.name: ShipSpareAssist
runs.description: A procurement assistant tailored for technical superintendents ordering ship spares.
runs.brief: Build a procurement assistant for technical superintendents ordering ship spares. It should find parts in the spares catalogue by part number, description, category or vessel class, and report unit price, lead time, minimum order quantity, stock and supplier. It must calculate order totals (quantity x unit price) and apply supplier volume discounts, and explain each supplier's payment terms, delivery terms and warranty conditions. It should also show live stock-market prices of our suppliers and calculate customs duty for imported parts. It must not approve purchase orders or negotiate prices on anyone's behalf.
